WITH per_media_type AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_list_price,
    AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_size_per_millisecond
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
), with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    media_type_name,
    avg_list_price,
    avg_size_per_millisecond,
    AVG(avg_size_per_millisecond) OVER () AS overall_avg_size_per_millisecond
  FROM per_media_type
)
SELECT
  media_type_name,
  avg_list_price,
  avg_size_per_millisecond,
  avg_size_per_millisecond / overall_avg_size_per_millisecond AS relative_avg_size_per_millisecond
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_avg_size_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The plain average across media types gives each media type with qualifying tracks equal weight, averaging its per-track size-to-length average; media types with no qualifying tracks do not contribute.
